title: FBI Photo A005
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video/targeting-system still with overlaid reticle and redacted bars
pages.description: A grayscale aerial or surveillance-style image showing a textured ground surface with mottled light and dark patches resembling terrain or foliage. A white crosshair reticle is centered in the image with a horizontal scale bar marked with tick increments. A small dark circular dot appears just below and left of the reticle center. A small white circle is near the upper portion. Numerous solid black rectangular bars of various sizes obscure portions of the image along the top, sides, and bottom edges, appearing to be redactions or masked overlay elements.
